qualifier: spanning ceramide/sphingomyelin synthesis, glycolipid transport and lysosomal ganglioside catabolism
name: Sphingolipid and glycosphingolipid synthesis, transport and lysosomal catabolism
rationale: All members concern sphingolipid and glycosphingolipid synthesis, transport or lysosomal breakdown; unlike C1 it has the ganglioside/lysosomal side and unlike C2-C4 it has the ceramide/sphingomyelin side.

qualifier: YAP/TAZ-driven transcription and cell density sensing
name: Hippo signaling and YAP/TAZ-driven transcription
rationale: Members are Hippo pathway regulation, density sensing and YAP1/TAZ transcriptional output, which PTK6, RUNX3, Wnt and PDGF/mechanoresponsive confusables lack.

qualifier: with Golgi GDP-fucose/CMP-sialic acid transporter defects
name: GDP-fucose synthesis and Golgi GDP-fucose/CMP-sialic acid transport defects
rationale: Members are GDP-fucose biosynthesis and the SLC35C1/SLC35A1 transporter disorders; confusables cover other nucleotide sugars (UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-Gal) or downstream fucosylation and blood groups.

qualifier: responding to dietary nutrients (fructose, fatty acids, caloric restriction)
name: SREBP-regulated lipid homeostasis responding to dietary nutrients
rationale: Members cover SREBP control of cholesterol synthesis and fatty acid homeostasis with nutritional responses, distinct from cholesterol transport/efflux (C1), SREBF motif modules (C2) and LXR/PPAR/PGC1 programs (C3, C4).

qualifier: of lineage differentiation and signaling genes
name: RUNX1-mediated transcription of lineage differentiation and signaling genes
rationale: All members are RUNX1 (or RUNX-family) regulation of target genes across myeloid, megakaryocyte, B cell, keratinocyte and estrogen/WNT/interleukin programs, unlike megakaryocyte development (C1), Hox clusters (C2, C3) or FLT3/STAT5 signaling (C4).

qualifier: with post-translational control of PTEN stability and localization
name: PTEN post-translational control and AKT kinase signaling
rationale: Members concern AKT activation and targets and PTEN protein stability/localization, whereas confusables cover PTEN translational silencing by ceRNAs (C1, C2) or nuclear phosphoinositide signaling (C3, C4).

qualifier: severing, barbed-end capping, depolymerization
name: Actin filament severing, capping, depolymerization and crosslinking
rationale: Members concern severing, capping, depolymerizing and crosslinking actin filaments (including caspase cleavage of such proteins), unlike nucleation/lamellipodia (C1, C3), focal adhesion bundles (C2) or filopodia (C4).

core: Endothelial cell differentiation and vessel morphogenesis
qualifier: via VEGFR2 and Tie2 signaling, arterial/venous/lymphatic specification
name: Endothelial cell differentiation and vessel morphogenesis via VEGFR2/Tie2
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate, arteriovenous and lymphatic specification and VEGF/VEGFR2/Tie2 signaling, unlike BMP-driven cardiopulmonary vasculature (C1, C2) or regulation of sprouting angiogenesis (C3, C4).

qualifier: precursor processing and IL-1 production
name: Interleukin-1 precursor processing and production
rationale: All three members concern processing of IL-1 cytokine precursors and IL-1 production, without the inflammasome/pyroptosis, IL-17 or broad inflammatory cytokine content of the confusables.

qualifier: linkage-specific polyubiquitination and deubiquitinase editing
name: Linkage-specific polyubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitinase editing
rationale: Members are E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination of specific lysine linkages and DUB families that edit chains, rather than proteasomal degradation and quality control (C1, C4), neddylation (C2) or NF-kB regulation (C3).

qualifier: downstream second messengers to NF-kB and IL-2
name: Downstream T cell receptor signaling to NF-kB and IL-2
rationale: Members cover distal antigen-receptor signaling (second messengers, ITK/PKC, NF-kB activation, IL-2 production), unlike CD28 costimulation and proximal CD3/ZAP-70 events (C1-C3) or non-canonical NF-kB (C4).

qualifier: lung and salivary gland bud outgrowth
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and salivary branching morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling and mesenchymal proliferation driving lung, salivary and limb bud outgrowth, unlike prostate branching (C1) or later lung/trachea maturation (C2-C4).

qualifier: via ER store release and store-operated entry
name: Cytosolic calcium elevation via ER store release and store-operated entry
rationale: Members concern raising cytosolic Ca2+ by ER/SR release and store-operated channels, whereas confusables emphasize cardiac Ca2+ handling and Ca2+ removal (C1-C3) or mitochondria-ER contacts (C4).

core: G1/S transition and DNA replication initiation
qualifier: E2F-driven transcription and origin licensing
name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and replication origin licensing
rationale: Members cover E2F target expression and ORC/CDC6/MCM origin licensing and replication initiation, unlike stimulated T cell division (C1), DNA damage repair (C2, C3) or DREAM-mediated repression (C4).

qualifier: regulation of extrinsic apoptosis and necroptosis
name: Regulation of death receptor-induced apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members regulate TNF/TRAIL death-receptor apoptosis and necroptosis in either direction, unlike the mitochondrial apoptotic machinery (C1), Fas/caspase-8/T cell death (C2, C3) or core necroptotic signaling (C4).

qualifier: acrosome assembly, capacitation, acrosome reaction, zona pellucida penetration
name: Sperm acrosome assembly, acrosome reaction and zona pellucida penetration
rationale: All members concern acrosome biogenesis, capacitation and the acrosome-dependent binding and penetration of the egg coat, unlike sperm motility, germ cell development or the maternal-zygotic transition in confusables.

qualifier: with DREAM/p107-p130 repression of cell cycle genes
name: G2/M transition with DREAM-repressed cell cycle gene expression
rationale: Members cover cyclin B/CDK1, PLK and G2/M checkpoint events plus DREAM/RBL1-RBL2 control of E2F targets, unlike G1/S E2F programs (C1, C2, C4) or p53-driven G2 arrest (C3).

qualifier: including oncogenic BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K and RAS mutants
name: RAF-MEK-ERK kinase activation and its oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members are RAF activation, MAP2K/MAPK/RSK activation and the mutant BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K/MRAS-SHOC2 variants, unlike upstream RAS GAP/SOS regulation (C1, C3), integrin-MAPK linkage (C2) or ERK negative regulation (C4).

core: Cytochrome P450 fatty acid and eicosanoid oxidation
qualifier: omega-hydroxylation and epoxygenation
name: Cytochrome P450 hydroxylation and epoxidation of fatty acids and eicosanoids
rationale: Members cover CYP omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase metabolism of arachidonic/linoleic acids (HETEs, EETs) and related CYP4F22/fatty acid disorders, unlike the lipoxygenase and leukotriene pathways of confusables.

core: Protein delivery to the cell surface
qualifier: exocyst- and RHOQ-dependent, including GLUT4 translocation
name: Exocyst- and RHOQ-dependent protein delivery to the cell surface
rationale: Members concern Golgi-to-plasma membrane delivery and surface localization via exocyst tethering and RHOQ (GLUT4 translocation), whereas confusables center on apical/raft sorting, CFTR trafficking or glucose import.

qualifier: with dendritic cell antigen presentation and IL-12 signaling
name: Immunological synapse formation and T cell-dendritic cell antigen presentation
rationale: Members cover synapse formation, T cell polarity, raft localization and dendritic cell antigen presentation/IL-12 signaling, unlike leukocyte adhesion/migration and RHO GTPase effector themes in confusables.

qualifier: N-glycan, GPI-anchor, glycolipid and nucleotide-sugar pathways and their disorders
name: N-glycan, GPI-anchor and glycolipid glycosylation and congenital disorders
rationale: Most members concern nucleotide-sugar supply, dolichol N-glycosylation, GPI anchoring, glycosphingolipids and their CDG/lysosomal disorders, whereas confusables center on proteoglycan/GAG, O-mannosyl and Notch O-fucosylation or mucopolysaccharidoses.

qualifier: apical membrane raft targeting
name: Polarized Golgi-to-plasma membrane protein sorting and apical raft targeting
rationale: Members concern Golgi-to-surface transport with apical/basolateral sorting and raft localization, unlike CFTR/transepithelial transport and lipid flippase themes (C1-C3) or general cell-surface localization (C4).

qualifier: IL-6, IL-8, TNF output and IL-1 signaling regulation
name: Inflammatory cytokine production and IL-1 signaling regulation
rationale: Members regulate production of IL-6, IL-8, TNF and IL-1alpha and IL-1/Toll signaling, unlike TLR3/TLR4 and CD40 regulation (C1-C3) or inflammasome IL-1beta processing (C4).

qualifier: with IGF and peptide hormone responsiveness
name: Osteoclast formation and bone resorption with IGF response
rationale: Members cover osteoclast differentiation, fusion, proliferation and bone resorption plus IGF/peptide responses, unlike macrophage fusion (C1), bone mineralization (C2, C3) or osteoblast regulation (C4).
